name: AttachThreadReply
description: Attaches an inbound email that IngestEmail recognised as a reply (isThreadReply=true, threadOf / linkedTable / linkedId already set) to what it answers, instead of opening a new inquiry. Reply to an outbox row (Approvals): updates lastReplyEmailId, lastReplyAt, replyCount on that row; when it belongs to a case (Disputes), adds an Interactions row on the case and sets the case back to active. Reply to an earlier inbound email: the original email goes back to handlingState לא טופל (reopened) and the reply copies its categories, customer and bookkeeper. The reply row itself gets status / handlingState לא טופל, classifiedBy קוד, and the inherited customer. Idempotent per email. Sends nothing.

inboundEmailId.description: InboundEmails row id of the reply

summary.description: Hebrew one-liner of what was attached
